idea-plugin.name: OfficeFloor IoCC
idea-plugin.description:
Visualises OfficeFloor WoOF / Activity "compose" YAML endpoints as an auto-laid-out flow diagram. Open an endpoint configuration file and a Flow tab appears next to the text editor, showing the functions flowing down the page.

Two independent overlays let you switch between what the endpoint does and what data moves through it:

  • Control flow: the next, outputs and escalations connections between functions.
  • Data flow: the variables each function reads and writes (@Val, In, Out, Var) and the value passed to the next function's @Parameter, drawn as overlay lines.

Click a function to jump to the Java method that implements it, or to its declaration in the YAML. Click a connection to jump to the line that declares it.

For OfficeFloor on Spring Boot REST.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.5.2: fixes 0.5.1, which could price a method differently from 0.5.0 when several statements share a line inside a loop or if (SinewSlim 0.2.3). Generated tables are still priced in minutes; the shortcut that took a flat method whole is removed, as the faster search makes it unneeded.
  • 0.5.1: Generated tables of thousands of statements (an encoding detector's frequencies, a parser's keyword map) are priced in minutes rather than hours. It could price a method differently when several statements share a line inside a loop or if: fixed in 0.5.2.
  • 0.5.0: A long function's split drawn on the graph itself. Click its badge and the function is replaced by the functions it would split into, dashed amber, joined by their flows, and the graph is laid out again; click again to put it back. A link that skips a layer is routed round the side, not behind the node between. Clicking a function no longer looks its Java method up on the UI thread, which IntelliJ reported as a slow operation. Long flat methods, such as GUI builders generate, are priced in seconds rather than hours, with the same results.
  • 0.4.0: Long functions marked on the flow diagram. A function whose method is 26 code lines or more has an amber outline and its length as a badge. Hover it, or click the badge to keep it open, to preview how it splits: into functions where the flow divides, with any methods to extract inside them, and what each costs. Each row goes to its line in the source. The "Long functions" check box turns it off.
  • 0.3.0: No change to the plugin. The release adds the combined split to OfficeFloorSlim's command line and image: functions where the flow divides, with extracted methods inside them.
  • 0.2.1: Renamed "OfficeFloor IoCC" (was "OfficeFloor REST View"), and now released from the OfficeFloorSlim repository (its 0.2.0 was not released to the Marketplace: the name "OfficeFloor" is already taken there). The flow diagram is read by the same rules as OfficeFloorSlim's command line, so both give the same graph; what the diagram shows is otherwise unchanged.
  • 0.1.1: Signed by OfficeFloor: each release now carries the OfficeFloor signature as well as JetBrains'.
  • 0.1.0: Initial release. Flow diagram with control-flow and data-flow overlays, and jump-to-source navigation.
